content: A1-sdk-harness PASSES. No product code changed — the conformance suite gateway/ai_mesh_gateway/tests/test_openai_sdk_compat.py already existed and is complete (REAL app over httpx.ASGITransport + stock openai SDK, only upstream provider stubbed; covers chat non-stream/stream/tool_calls/json_schema/usage, responses non-stream/typed-stream-D5/previous_response_id/store-retrieve-delete/input-items, embeddings single+batch, models list+retrieve-D4, errors with class + e.code/type/param/message + e.request_id across error classes, clean-404). Gate `cd gateway && ./.venv/bin/python -m pytest ai_mesh_gateway/tests/test_openai_sdk_compat.py -q` = 25 passed, 4 xpassed (D2/D3/D4/D5 non-strict xfail XPASS = fixed in-tree). openai pinned exactly at openai==2.38.0 in gateway/pyproject.toml dev deps; recorded in progress.txt per criterion 3. GOTCHA: full suite `pytest ai_mesh_gateway/tests -q` has 17 PRE-EXISTING failures in OTHER files (bedrock, live_uvicorn run-separately, phase5/phase6 global-mutation, policy_check, stream_governance, context_guard, org_tpm) — not A1, do not block on them. Only edit needed was the progress.txt note + flip prd.json passes:true.

A2-egress-rig DONE (commits 11025fa9 + ebe645ac). Built pytest leak-hunt suite at gateway/tests/leakhunt/ (gate: `cd gateway && ./.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/leakhunt -q` → 6 passed, 1 xfailed). NOT repo-root tests/leakhunt (that's the mitmproxy capture_addon.py only). Files: conftest.py adds ai_mesh_gateway to sys.path (suite is OUTSIDE the package so package conftest doesn't load) + its own dir for flat `import corpus`/`import recording_provider`. corpus.py = PiiItem dataclass + CORPUS (phone formats us_3_3_4/dotted/paren/bare10_contextual/intl_e164/intl_cc_dash + KNOWN LEAK us_5_5_spaced + by-design pass-through bare10_no_cue; .covered flag, KNOWN_LEAKS/REDACTABLE views). recording_provider.py = RecordingProvider.install(monkeypatch) patches litellm.acompletion/aembedding/aresponses (egress choke point when LLMRouter org_only_inference=True empties router → dispatch falls to module-level litellm). serialize_wire=json.dumps(kwargs,default=str). assert_no_pii_egressed(corpus) substring-scans .wires; independent_pii_scan oracle regexes SEPARATE from patterns.py. RecordingVectorStore captures at-rest documents+metadata for B5. test_rig_selfcheck.py has a NEGATIVE CONTROL proving the assertion RAISES on a real leak (no no-op gate). test_repro_g0.py = xfail strict=False. G0 ROOT CAUSE (for B2/B1): redact_all phone patterns AND _redact_text_with_backstop's re.findall(r"\d{7,}") are BOTH contiguous-digit only → any separator-split phone (5+5 spaced "89295 54991") behind a phone cue bypasses both and egresses raw though the verdict fired. ruff NOT installed in gateway/.venv. Reuse RecordingProvider+corpus+assert_no_pii_egressed for B1/B3/B4; RecordingVectorStore for B5 at-rest.

C1-error-envelope PASSES. Choke point already existed from prior OpenAI-compat PHASE work: _openai_compat_shim BaseHTTPMiddleware (main.py:254) registered OUTSIDE auth — rewrites flat {error,message,code} -> nested OpenAI envelope via responses_adapters.coerce_chat_error_to_openai (idempotent) + guarantees x-request-id on EVERY /v1 response (prefers handler-set request.state.gw_request_id so header==body). No product code changed; only flipped 2 cells from xfail(strict=False) to real passing: test_error_fields_populated_on_block_D2 (e.code/e.type/e.message non-None) + test_error_request_id_present_on_block_D3 (e.request_id). D4/D5 stay xfail (C4/C3). Gate: pytest test_openai_sdk_compat.py -> 27 passed/2 xpassed. GOTCHA: ruff not installed in gateway/.venv (skip). PATTERN: C/D fix stories often already landed in-tree via shim+responses_adapters — verify+flip xfail, don't re-implement.

B2-redactor-coverage PASSES (gate green). Closed G0 detector gap: 5+5 spaced phone behind a phone cue ("please call me at 89295 54991") egressed RAW because redact_all's phone_us_bare_contextual only matched contiguous \d{10}. FIX in patterns.py (single choke point): added module const _BARE_PHONE_10_SPLIT = (\d{10}|\d{5}[sep]\d{5}|\d{4}[sep]\d{6}|\d{3}[sep]\d{3}[sep]\d{4}|\d{3}[sep]\d{7}) where sep=[\s.\-]; swapped the pattern's trailing `\d{10}\b` for _BARE_PHONE_10_SPLIT+\b; updated _mask_phone_bare_contextual to locate via same const and re.sub(\D,"") before last-4 mask. FP-safety preserved BY CONSTRUCTION: coverage stays context-gated on the existing phone-cue alternation, so order-id/revenue runs with no cue (order/ref number/invoice + digits) never match. Exactly-10-digit total + trailing \b => an 11+ digit id fails \b after 10 contiguous and has no split branch => left raw (no partial mask). +CC already covered by phone_intl; bare10_no_cue stays intentional pass-through. Test side: flipped corpus us_5_5_spaced covered=True (KNOWN_LEAKS now empty), converted test_repro_g0 from xfail RED to GREEN closure regression (pull from CORPUS by fmt not KNOWN_LEAKS), added tests/leakhunt/test_b2_redactor_coverage.py (parametrized every covered phone format absent from egress wire + redact_all FP suite + e2e order-id-on-wire). GATE: cd gateway && PYTHONPATH="../shared:$PWD:$PWD/ai_mesh_gateway" ./.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/leakhunt -q => 30 passed. REGRESSION PROOF: full ai_mesh_gateway/tests = 20 failed identical to stash-baseline run (same node ids; 3 are parallel-session mcp_sandbox_integration + 17 documented pre-existing) => ZERO new failures. REUSABLE PATTERN: broaden a context-gated detector by swapping ONLY the trailing value sub-pattern (keep the cue alternation); mask via same const + \D strip. Commits 7ec3228a (impl) + 203853b2 (flip). Unblocks B5.

B5-rag-at-rest LANDED (commit 36ac9cfa). G2 at-rest gate: nothing raw PII embedded/stored in the vector store (documents OR metadata). KEY INSIGHT: the at-rest guarantee was ALREADY policy-forced by input_scan_enabled (default True) via the B4 unified pass (main._scan_redact_embedding_inputs for content + main._scan_redact_metadata for metadata, both run in rag_ingest before client.add regardless of rag_redaction_enabled). So B5 = (1) flipped rag_ingest rag_redaction_enabled default False->True at main.py ~10182 for typed-placeholder defense-in-depth, NOT the core guarantee; (2) built tests/leakhunt/test_b5_rag_at_rest.py (5 tests) that drives those exact helpers, PERSISTS to a REAL chromadb collection, and QUERIES it directly (col.get include=documents,metadatas). Backend: prefer live :8001 server when full create/add/get round-trip works else in-process EphemeralClient — both real chromadb. GATE: cd gateway && ./.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/leakhunt -q -> 89 passed,1 skipped. GOTCHAS: (a) create EphemeralClient ONCE per module via scope=module fixture handing out fresh collection names — 2nd call raises 'instance already exists for ephemeral with different settings'; (b) chromadb metadata values must be SCALAR -> JSON-serialize nested redacted metadata to one field then scan; (c) pass explicit per-doc embeddings to avoid ONNX model download; (d) the local :8001 chroma server is version-mismatched (create_collection KeyError _type) so the live path falls back to embedded; (e) a context-gated PII value (bare-10-digit 8929554991, 5+5 split 89295 54991, no-sep SSN 123456789) placed in metadata WITHOUT a phone/ssn cue is order-id-shaped + intentionally KEPT (corpus.intentional pass-through) — build metadata in natural cued phrasing item.prompt()==cue+raw, NOT bare item.raw, or the at-rest assertion forces over-redaction. test_e10 test_scan_redact_helper_blocks_unmaskable_pii failure is PRE-EXISTING (reproduces with main.py change stashed). REMAINING backlog: only D1-D6 UI/browser stories (priority 3).

C1-error-envelope RIGOR-VERIFIED 2026-06-29 (commit 64099293), NO gap. The /v1 request-id+nested-envelope invariant is UNIVERSAL across 3 layers: (1) _openai_compat_shim main.py:254 (BaseHTTPMiddleware, OUTSIDE auth — stamps x-request-id on EVERY /v1 resp incl 401/404/200/SSE; coerces flat error bodies via coerce_chat_error_to_openai; adds Retry-After on 429/503; SSE short-circuit happens AFTER the header is set); (2) @app.exception_handler(StarletteHTTPException) main.py:198 (inner, turns FastAPI flat {"detail"} into nested build_openai_error for /v1, incl unmatched-route 404); (3) _unhandled_handler main.py:170 (OUTER ServerErrorMiddleware — escaped-handler 500s bypass the shim, so this handler ITSELF emits nested envelope+request_id, no traceback leak). Added 5 durable adversarial cells test_c1_* to test_openai_sdk_compat.py (success/streaming/unmatched-404/malformed-json/escaped-500). GATE GOTCHA: must run with PYTHONPATH="$PWD/../shared" else 30 ERRORS ModuleNotFoundError ai_mesh_shared (env-only, not a regression). Full harness 35 passed/2 xpassed.

A1-sdk-harness rigor-verified 2026-06-29 (commit 3b81737f). REAL GAP found+fixed: the documented gate `cd gateway && ./.venv/bin/python -m pytest ai_mesh_gateway/tests -q` false-failed with ~39 ERRORS `ModuleNotFoundError: ai_mesh_shared` at FIXTURE SETUP from a clean shell (no PYTHONPATH). Cause: main.py -> jobs.py + line67 import ai_mesh_shared which lives at repo-root/shared, not on sys.path; fixtures import main lazily so collection passes but every test errors. DURABLE FIX = prepend gateway/ai_mesh_gateway + repo-root/shared to sys.path at TOP of package conftest gateway/ai_mesh_gateway/conftest.py (mirrors tests/leakhunt/conftest.py). After: 39 passed/2 xpassed clean shell; 1011 collected 0 errors. PATTERN: test-harness path fix belongs in conftest (loaded before fixtures), NOT in env PYTHONPATH. Harness is non-hollow: stock openai.AsyncOpenAI over httpx.ASGITransport max_retries=0, asserts parsed pydantic + e.code/type/param/message + e.request_id across 401/403/400/429/404. Path-only change, enforcement untouched.

C2-dead-route rigor-verified 2026-06-29. Single POST /v1/responses at main.py:8382 (proxy_responses, full-featured: streaming/_translate_chat_stream_to_responses, store/_ResponseStore + raw_body.get('store'), previous_response_id). GAP CLOSED: literal-path route-count test (test_only_one_post_v1_responses_route) is necessary but NOT sufficient — Starlette is first-match-wins so an earlier param/regex route (/v1/{rest:path}) could shadow it. PROOF: probe r.matches({type:http,method:POST,path:/v1/responses}) over app.router.routes, collect Match.FULL endpoints in order -> exactly ['proxy_responses']. Added durable cell test_v1_responses_first_match_wins_is_full_handler. Gate: env -u PYTHONPATH ./.venv/bin/python -m pytest ai_mesh_gateway/tests/test_openai_sdk_compat.py -q -> 40 passed/2 xpassed. Pattern: to prove a route isn't shadowed, assert the RESOLVED endpoint name, not just the literal path count.

C3-responses-stream rigor-verified 2026-06-29. Translator _translate_chat_stream_to_responses (main.py:8184) emits canonical lifecycle response.created->output_item.added->content_part.added->output_text.delta*->output_text.done->output_item.done->response.completed, and response.failed (status=failed, .error populated, output_text="") on a mid-stream output_blocked/zeroshield-action=error frame. GAP FOUND+CLOSED: failed path was only asserted at translator-unit level (test_responses_stream_errors.py, test_p2_phase6_holes.py check raw SSE bytes) — never through the stock openai SDK. Added durable SDK-transport cell test_responses_mid_stream_failure_surfaces_typed_response_failed: monkeypatch gateway_main.LLM_ROUTER.acompletion_stream to yield a content delta then an {"error":{code:output_blocked}} frame, drive stock client.responses.create(stream=True), assert SDK decodes terminal typed ResponseFailedEvent, no phantom completed. Harness 47 passed/2 xpassed. PATTERN: SDK-stream stories must drive stock SDK over httpx.ASGITransport (exercise the SDK's own event decoder), not just assert translator bytes; inject mid-stream failures by overriding LLM_ROUTER.acompletion_stream. proxy_responses wraps the chat StreamingResponse.body_iterator through the translator (main.py:8453).

C4-thin-endpoints rigor-verified 2026-06-29 (no code change; 5 durable test cells added). All D4 thin surfaces already correct in main.py: retrieve_model (12187), create_moderations (12203), create_legacy_completion (12258), _openai_surface_unimplemented loop (12367-12382 covers files/batches/images/audio/fine_tuning). Gate was HOLLOW: moderations had ZERO SDK cell, audio-404 + retrieve-404 untested. Added test_c4_* to test_openai_sdk_compat.py: moderations benign (parsed Moderation, std Categories bools, m._request_id==m.id SEAM-C join), moderations injection (categories.model_extra['prompt_injection']==True), moderations missing-input (NESTED envelope+x-request-id via C1 shim), audio.speech.create->NotFoundError 404, models.retrieve(unknown)->404+request_id. Gate: env -u PYTHONPATH ./.venv/bin/python -m pytest ai_mesh_gateway/tests/test_openai_sdk_compat.py -q -> 46 passed/2 xpassed. PATTERN: SDK surface not proven until the SDK's OWN typed accessor is driven (client.moderations.create / client.audio.* / client.models.retrieve on hit+miss); a main.py handler + raw-httpx 200 is necessary but not sufficient — the SDK decoder is the oracle.

A2-egress-rig RIGOR-VERIFIED 2026-06-29 (commit e490ea75). Gate: cd gateway && ./.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/leakhunt -q -> 89 passed, 1 skipped (skip=test_b4:168 by-design FP-protected bare10_no_cue). Rig: gateway/tests/leakhunt/recording_provider.py monkeypatches litellm.acompletion/aembedding/aresponses (= egress choke when org_only_inference=True). Trustworthy: test_rig_selfcheck has TWO real negative controls (pytest.raises). Corpus covers bare-10/5+5-spaced/+CC-10. ADVERSARIAL: full 17-item covered corpus through REAL redact_pii+router+embeddings -> 0 leaks; THREE oracles converge (patterns.py, rig independent_pii_scan, aidefence_has_pii) -> hasPII:false on masked egress, hasPII:true on raw control. PATTERN: leak-GATE rigor = negative-control RAISES + faithful capture + 3rd independent oracle agrees on captured bytes AND fires on raw.

B4 LANDED 2026-06-29. Root cause: two redaction engines diverged on the broadened bare-contextual-phone SPAN. patterns.redact_all uses _mask_phone_bare_contextual (rewrites ONLY the trailing digit run, preserves cue/gap prefix) so a nested email in the gap survives + is masked by its own pass. typed_placeholder_redactor.detect_and_redact_typed (RAG-ingest/at-rest/e11 returned-doc engine) WHOLE-SPAN replaces + overlap-merges (longest span wins) so the broadened phone span ("contact <email>, call back on <phone>") SWALLOWED the nested email -> [EMAIL] dropped = test_e11_egress_default_path regression. FIX: narrow the typed redactor's phone_us_bare_contextual collected span to the trailing phone value (re-search _BARE_PHONE_10_SPLIT inside the match, mirroring _mask_phone_bare_contextual). Both engines now structurally identical: chat/embed ...***-***-4991, typed/at-rest ...[PHONE], email preserved. GOTCHA: after ANY patterns.py span broadening run BOTH test_e11 (typed/at-rest) AND tests/leakhunt/test_b4_* (chat-vs-embed differential); leakhunt alone misses typed-engine swallow. Independent oracle aidefence_has_pii over typed egress=false, raw=true. 33 other broad-run failures (bedrock, mcp_sandbox[Docker], live_uvicorn, phase5/6, org_tpm, policy_check, stream_governance, context_guard) are PRE-EXISTING combined-run global-mutation artifacts (identical with src stashed), pass individually.

B2 rigor-verified 2026-06-29 (commit 7f53d41c). Method: drove REAL InputScanner+LLMRouter egress path (RecordingProvider wire capture) with NEW phone formats not in corpus. Classify each leak: PHANTOM (scanner removed from redacted_content but raw on wire = egress=truth/B1 violation = always real gap) vs COVERAGE-only (scanner never flagged, no redact claim, judged vs B2 conservative FP contract). ALL phone leaks were coverage-only, none phantom. ORACLE GOTCHA: aidefence_has_pii does NOT treat phone numbers as PII (only email/SSN/keys/passwords) — for phone leaks use corpus phone_sep regex / independent_pii_scan as oracle. FIX: phone_intl grouped branch \d{1,3}(?:[\s-]\d{1,4}){2,6} capped groups at 4 digits, missing common 5+5 intl grouping (+91 98765 43210 India/EU). Widened to \d{1,5}; FP-safe because +-anchored E.164 marker. LEFT by design (non-phantom+high-FP+not-PII): bare 2+4+4, slash/underscore seps, whatsapp cue, 00-intl prefix. Gate leakhunt 101 passed. Pre-existing unrelated failures: test_policy_check_input_scan tier1_injection (fail on clean tree + isolation).

B3 rigor-verified 2026-06-29 (commit a85c26c9). Re-proved /v1/embeddings scan+redact via FULL HTTP proxy_embeddings (not just _scan_redact_embedding_inputs helper). Standalone harness: real app + httpx.ASGITransport + stock openai AsyncOpenAI.embeddings.create, wrap LLM_ROUTER.aembedding to capture forwarded body=egress. 6 PII formats all neutralized on wire (email/ssn/phone/intl-5+5/sk-proj/card); B2 phone_intl widening honored transitively via shared _redact_text_with_backstop. Independent oracle aidefence_has_pii: redacted egress hasPII=false, raw hasPII=true. GOTCHA: proxy_embeddings fails closed 503 kill_switch_active when REDIS_CLIENT=None unless org_config kill_switch_enabled:False — mirror SDK harness TEST_CONFIG for stateless in-process embeddings drive. No source change; gates green leakhunt 101/1, test_embedding_input_redaction 10, SDK embeddings 2.

B4 rigor-verified 2026-06-29. Unified egress: chat (_apply_redaction) + embeddings/RAG/metadata (_scan_redact_embedding_inputs) BOTH use llm_router._redact_text_with_backstop(text, redact_pii(verdict)) — byte-identical by construction. RESPONSES differs: aresponses replaces input with redacted_content directly (NOT backstop) — proven redact_pii(p)==backstop(p,redact_pii) over corpus+multi-PII. Oracle aidefence_has_pii: raw=true, redacted=false. GOTCHA: empty org_only router 404s in aresponses before litellm.aresponses; assert responses==chat at redaction-fn level. Gate: test_b4 58 passed, leakhunt 120 passed.

B5 rigor-verified 2026-06-29 (no gap). Real rag_ingest handler funnels every allowed doc through SAME unified helpers the gate drives: content _scan_redact_embedding_inputs (main.py ~10370) + metadata _scan_redact_metadata (~10386), reassigns doc_strings/normalized_metas. Sync stores those (client.add ~10469); async hands same redacted payload to worker — and async vector_ingest_task (workers/.../tasks/telemetry.py:730) is a NO-OP placeholder storing nothing. ROBUSTNESS: both helpers gated only by input_scan_enabled (default True), NOT rag_redaction_enabled, so at-rest guarantee survives org disabling the B5 default; typed [EMAIL]/[SSN] is defense-in-depth only. Verified full REDACTABLE corpus + 6 adversarial extras at-rest: 0 raw, separate-regex oracle==[] AND aidefence_has_pii ML oracle==hasPII:false (positive control raw->piiFound:true). Fail-closed: unmaskable content->not stored, unmaskable meta->"[REDACTED]". Long-tail (not a gap): AWS secret key w/o AKIA prefix persists raw but aidefence also misses it+out of corpus = documented tier-2-ML deferral. Gate: cd gateway && ./.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/leakhunt -q -> 120 passed 1 skipped.

D1-ui-auth-keys rigor-verified. Gate: cd frontend && npm run build + NODE_PATH=tests/e2e/node_modules BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8180 node scripts/playwright_auth_keys.mjs -> 19/19 asserts, 0 pageErrors. HONESTY ORACLE=live GET /api/kill-switches/ + PUT /api/firewall/config/ echo; UI badge/toggle valid only if ==backend. D3-ui-rag-vector rigor-verified 2026-06-29 (commit ae993881). Gate scripts/playwright_rag_vector.mjs → 14/14, 0 pageErrors (run from frontend/ with NODE_PATH=tests/e2e/node_modules, BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8180). Build green. SUBSTANCE of D3 = multi-provider fan-out timeout fix in rag_collections.py (asyncio.wait_for per-provider RAG_LIST_COLLECTIONS_TIMEOUT default 4s + asyncio.gather). Adversarial backend proof: timed GET /api/admin/gateway/rag/collections/ → HTTP 200 status=ok TIME=4.79s (< control admin-proxy 10s read budget); the org3 e2e-fixture pinecone provider at example.com (permanent dead landmine) degrades to 0 collections instead of blocking. Pre-fix sequential ~18s → gateway_unreachable. Fix present in source AND running container (docker exec grep RAG_LIST_COLLECTIONS_TIMEOUT). DOCUMENTED ENV ITEM (not a D3 gap): chroma collection CREATE 500s — chromadb python-client vs server VERSION MISMATCH KeyError('_type'); gate takes error branch and proves UI honesty (Create failed shown, no phantom row, no backend leak). No source change, no real gap. D4-ui-mcp rigor-verified 2026-06-29. Module 1.4 MCP Guardrails (?tab=firewall-1-4). Customer-reachable control surface = MCPConnectorPanel only (6 internal tabs: Servers/Tool Discovery/Tool Execution/Scan Controls/MCP Security Policies/Observability); MCPManagerPanel+MCPScannerPanel are NOT wired to any route. Durable gate scripts/playwright_mcp_panels.mjs = 27/27 live (counts==backend, CRUD side-effect-free, scan-default PATCH both ways, allow-verdict honesty). ADVERSARIAL ADD: negative-path UI honesty proven live — schema-invalid echo call ({"message":12345}) -> backend HTTP 400 reason=invalid_arguments with NO decision field -> UI shows honest "HTTP 400" badge + reason + ZERO phantom "Allow". CODE-PROOF: verdict badge = decisionInfo(executeResult.decision) at MCPConnectorPanel.jsx:1783; lib/mcpColors.js maps allow->Allow/success, block->Block/danger, falsy->Error; cannot fabricate Allow. Tool-call API body {name,arguments,server_slug}; block outcomes: tool_not_registered->403, invalid_arguments->400, tool_disabled->403, output-PII block->200+decision:block. GOTCHAS: (1) local control = single daphne worker; opening streaming module pages in repeated playwright runs WEDGES daphne (all endpoints HTTP 000) -> recover via docker restart ai_mesh_firewall-control-1 (~60s boot incl 66-key resync). (2) POST /api/auth/token/ is rate-limited (429) — never tight-loop login to warm-check; poll a cheap GET instead. (3) execution tool picker populates only after Tool Discovery loads the shared tools state. Single clean run on warm stack is deterministically green. No source change; no product gap.

Durable gate scripts/playwright_output_logs.mjs -> 29/29 asserts, 0 pageErrors against live stack (Vite :8180->control :8100+gateway :8300). Pattern: anchor UI-honesty on ENFORCED bytes — mint short-lived gateway key, drive ONE live /v1/chat/completions with KNOWN raw PII (555-867-5309/alex.rivera@acmecomp.com), confirm verdict==redact + returned content masked, delete key. Then assert raw PII appears in NO operator surface; *** present; counts (governance chips, Detailed Records N) == backend /api/security/threat-feed (event_type output_guard|output_scan). Only legit email in capture = operator's own admin@zeroshield.io (nav identity, not leaked). No source change, no gap. Remaining round: D6-ui-demo-simulators.

A1-sdk-harness rigor-verified 2026-06-30. Gate: cd gateway && ./.venv/bin/python -m pytest ai_mesh_gateway/tests/test_openai_sdk_compat.py -q → 46 passed, 2 xpassed. The 2 xpasses are DOCUMENTED non-strict @xfail(strict=False) cells: D4 models.retrieve (main.py:11471) + D5 typed-stream (main.py:7815); fixes in-tree so XPASS expected. C1 rigor-verified 2026-06-30. Single /v1 shim choke point = main.py:255 _openai_compat_shim. Adversarial gate added: gateway/ai_mesh_gateway/tests/test_c1_error_envelope_adversarial.py (7 cells). Proves x-request-id stamped on no-handler paths (AuthMiddleware 401 -> nested envelope; unmatched /v1 router-404 coerced via responses_adapters.coerce_chat_error_to_openai), header==body request_id on content block, success body unmangled, /v1-scoped.
